purpose: Localize the v0.11 pair-level quality failure to exact atom/charge states without changing the atomic solver.
quality_definition: quality_pass = converged AND finite(energy_hartree) AND abs(virial_residual_hartree) < frozen virial_gate_hartree

interpretation_rules.convergence_failure: converged=false is recorded as an SCF-quality failure; no fallback outside the existing global ladder is introduced
interpretation_rules.virial_failure: converged=true but abs(virial)>=gate is recorded as a false/low-quality stationary control and remains failed
interpretation_rules.passed_state: may contribute to later control analysis only under the already-frozen caveats
interpretation_rules.failed_state: its derived v0.11 finite-difference descriptor is quantitatively inadmissible in the current control model

forbidden_after_readout: element- or charge-specific changes to basis, grid, damping, DIIS or virial threshold inside v0.11
substitution of experimental ionization/electron-affinity values only for failed states
calling a repaired calculation the original v0.11 blind result
fitting a classifier on the failed pair-level output
next_step_after_failure: If a state fails, either retire the descriptor from the common v0.11 vector or define a new globally applicable control method and preregister it as a new version before execution.
